Nathan Brooks is a Staff QA Engineer at Ludum Dynamics, a small gaming startup. His work balances precision and creativity, ensuring quality without slowing down innovation.  

Nathan owns the test strategy for Ludum’s flagship game, refining processes to cut post-launch bug reports by 40% during its first cycle. He prioritizes player-facing risks, often redesigning test scenarios mid-sprint to align with shifting dev priorities. His approach isn’t just about catching errors—it’s about shaping how the team thinks about quality.  

He’s the go-to person when deadlines loom. Last quarter, he rebuilt a fragmented testing framework into a shared playbook, saving the team 20+ hours across multiple projects. His knack for distilling complex systems into clear, actionable steps makes him indispensable.  

Nathan’s detail-oriented and relentlessly curious. He’ll dig into edge cases others overlook, and his calm under pressure ensures the team stays focused. If you need someone who turns uncertainty into clarity, Nathan’s your person.
